ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there are three circles of the same size, arranged horizontally overlapping each other; the three centers are represented by black dots, and are on the same straight line. The middle circle passes through the centers of the left and right circles. The dashed arcs in the figure indicate circular arcs that are covered by overlap and do not belong to the outer boundary, and the solid arcs form the outer perimeter of the entire figure. Reasoning: The radius of each circle is R. Because the middle circle passes through the centers of the left and right circles, the distance between adjacent centers is R. For two circles both with radius R and with center distance R, the two centers and one intersection point form an equilateral triangle with side length R, so the angle subtended by the two intersection points at each center is 120°. Therefore the overlap of each adjacent pair of circles will cover the corresponding 120° minor arc on the circle. The exposed arc length of the left circle corresponds to an angle of 360° - 120° = 240°; the right circle likewise has 240° exposed. The left side of the middle circle is covered by the left circle by 120°, and the right side is covered by the right circle by 120°, leaving a total exposed arc angle of 360° - 120° - 120° = 120°. Therefore the total angle of the outer perimeter is 240° + 240° + 120° = 600°. The arc length of 600° on a circle with radius R is: (600/360)·2πR = 10πR/3.

raw_record.question_text: The diagram consists of three circles of equal radius $R$. The centres of those circles lie on a common straight line, and the middle circle goes through the centres of the other two circles. How big is the perimeter of the figure?

method.method_draft: First read the diagram as three congruent overlapping circles arranged horizontally; the visible outer boundary is made of arcs from the left, middle, and right circles, while dashed arcs indicate portions hidden inside overlaps. From the text, take each circle radius as R and the adjacent center distances as R because the middle circle passes through the centers of the two outer circles. For two equal circles whose centers are distance R apart, the chord of intersection subtends 120° at each center, so the covered/hidden minor arc on each participating circle is 120°. Thus the exposed arc on each outer circle is 360°−120°=240°. On the middle circle, the 120° arc covered by the left circle and the 120° arc covered by the right circle leave only two exposed arcs totaling 120°. The perimeter is therefore arc length for 240°+240°+120°=600° of radius R circle, namely (600/360)·2πR=10πR/3.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中有三个大小相同的圆，水平相互重叠排列；三个圆心用黑点表示，并且在同一直线上。中间圆经过左右两个圆的圆心，图中虚线弧表示被重叠遮住、不属于外边界的圆弧，实线弧组成整个图形的外周界。

推理：每个圆半径为 R。因为中间圆经过左右两个圆的圆心，所以相邻两个圆心之间的距离都是 R。对两个半径同为 R、圆心距为 R 的圆，两个圆心和一个交点构成边长为 R 的等边三角形，因此两交点在每个圆心处张成的夹角为 120°。所以每对相邻圆的重叠会遮住相应圆上的 120° 小弧。

左圆外露弧长对应角度为 360° - 120° = 240°；右圆同样外露 240°。中间圆左侧被左圆遮住 120°，右侧被右圆遮住 120°，剩下外露弧总角度为 360° - 120° - 120° = 120°。因此外周界总角度为 240° + 240° + 120° = 600°。

周长为半径 R 的圆上 600° 的弧长：
(600/360)·2πR = 10πR/3。
